competing_explanation: Any apparent gain may be caused by changed capacity, different initialization, data ordering, density composition, additional compute, VGG download/cache resolution, grouping mistakes, or selective reporting. The frozen four-arm factorial, exact local VGG identity, matched budgets, scene-level four-observation aggregation, fixed severity strata, full comparison family, capability contract, and generic ledger are intended to expose those alternatives rather than assume them away.
controls: b00_baseline: CARL off and density consistency off
b10_carl: CARL on and density consistency off
b01_consistency: CARL off and density consistency on
b11_combined: CARL on and density consistency on
EMA teacher uses another of the four haze observations for the same clear scene only when consistency is enabled; it shares the frozen update rule and never supplies inference input

CARL compares the prediction with its clear target and four same-scene hazy negatives; the fixed VGG state dict is loaded only from the declared local asset, with no weights= API, download, or cache fallback
all reported factorial main effects and interaction use the same predeclared grouped scene contrasts and no arm is selected after observing results
disabled_actions: confirmation, canary, locked-test, sealed-final, promotion, deployment, and publication claims
runtime download, weights API resolution, or cache fallback for VGG-19
post-processing, arm-specific tuning, changed data roles, changed metrics, changed thresholds, or result-adaptive extension
using C2 as a reproduction claim for the published K=5 FFA-Net/RESIDE CARL study

gates.reference: Exact route, code, checkpoint, VGG asset, data-role, grouping, arm, and gate identities must match the generated contract.
The SHA-bound completed-unit ledger must cover exactly every frozen arm, scene, haze observation, evaluation output, and grouped summary unit.
Simultaneous interval half-width for every fixed density stratum must not exceed 0.10 dB under the frozen planning bound.
The simultaneous lower bound for b11 minus b00 exceeds the predeclared meaningful effect of 0.10 dB, with CARL and consistency main effects plus interaction reported without selection.
The worst fixed density-stratum simultaneous lower bound for b11 minus b00 is not below -0.10 dB.

complete trainable ConvIR-B parameter scope in every arm; frozen backbone means identical architecture and initialization, not a non-trainable model
Haze4K 600 training clear-scene role, four same-scene haze observations, data ordering, crop and augmentation policy
optimizer, learning-rate schedule, batch shape, seed plan, total steps, inference route, metric code, output processing, and scene aggregation
density proxy construction before outcome access, fixed rank order, and three 50-scene severity strata

fixed VGG-19 ImageNet-1K V1 local state dict from https://download.pytorch.org/models/vgg19-dcbb9e9d.pth at /sda/home/wangyuxin/ConvIR-B/checkpoints/vgg19-dcbb9e9d.pth, exactly 574673361 bytes and SHA-256 dcbb9e9dad569fff7a846263a77324fc34978fea2bfb039c012d710e1776ae44; layers 1/3/5/9/13, weights 1/32,1/16,1/8,1/4,1, tau 0.5, lambda_consistency 1.0, lambda_CARL 10.0, and C2 K=4 negatives
intervention.matched_budget: four mutually exclusive arms each train the complete ConvIR-B parameter scope for the same fixed 2000-step budget on 600 Haze4K training original-clear scenes and evaluate the frozen 150-scene development screen with four haze observations per clear scene
intervention.primary_variable: the fixed 2x2 combination of CARL and same-clear-scene haze-density consistency losses
intervention.reference: b00_baseline with both loss terms disabled

primary_estimand.aggregation: For each original-clear scene, average the four haze-observation PSNR values within each arm, compute b11_combined minus b00_baseline, clip the scene contrast to [-0.25,0.25] dB before grouped analysis, and report the overall and fixed density-stratum means.

question: For the unchanged official ConvIR-B training path, do haze-density consistency and contrast-assisted reconstruction loss, alone or together, change grouped development-screening dehazing utility while preserving the worst density stratum?

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: C1's valid terminal FAIL is limited to an observable spatial-conditioning adapter. The open question is whether a fixed training-objective intervention, rather than an inference-time adapter, can improve the unchanged ConvIR-B path while maintaining density-stratum safety.

decision_design.alias_structure: This is a full two-factor two-level factorial. The intercept, two main effects, and CARL-by-consistency interaction are estimable without aliasing. The three density strata are fixed reporting strata, not treatment factors.

arms.description: CARL off and density consistency off.
CARL on and density consistency off.
CARL off and density consistency on.
CARL on and density consistency on.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: The CARL main-effect interval does not support a material directional effect under the fixed family.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The CARL main effect is reported from its predeclared balanced factorial contrast.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: The density-consistency main-effect interval does not support a material directional effect under the fixed family.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The density-consistency main effect is reported from its predeclared balanced factorial contrast.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: The combined primary gate is unfavorable or worst-stratum safety is unsafe.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: Combined utility is material and all three fixed density-stratum effects plus the worst-stratum safety analysis are available.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: A fixed eight-comparison family uses simultaneous two-sided Bonferroni 95% intervals: combined primary, CARL main effect, consistency main effect, interaction, three density-stratum combined effects, and the worst-stratum safety comparison.

boundaries.futility: No interim outcome look or result-adaptive early stop is permitted.
boundaries.precision: The fixed formal precision certificate determines only the inconclusive-only precision outcome.
boundaries.success: Only the complete terminal look may yield a favorable scientific result.
boundaries.validity: Identity, integrity, grouping, asset, coverage, and ledger failures produce the validity veto.

design_selection.decision_value: The four-arm 2x2 directly separates baseline, CARL, density consistency, and their interaction under one frozen training and evaluation path.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: One finite terminal evaluation after all four equal-budget arms and all fixed scene units complete.
design_selection.shared_setup: Every arm uses the same ConvIR-B architecture, checkpoint initialization, trainable scope, 600-scene Haze4K training role, 150-scene development role, optimizer, steps, seeds, and inference implementation.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: One same-scale protected-data-free GPU probe followed, only after explicit EXECUTE authorization, by four 2000-step arms and exact ledger coverage for the fixed train and development workload.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The predeclared CARL main-effect contrast is reported with the family-adjusted grouped interval.
hypotheses.falsifier: The CARL main-effect interval includes no useful evidence once the fixed comparison family is applied.
hypotheses.statement: Fixed CARL adds useful contrast-aware reconstruction supervision beyond the matched baseline objective.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The predeclared consistency main-effect contrast is reported with the family-adjusted grouped interval.
hypotheses.falsifier: The consistency main-effect interval includes no useful evidence once the fixed comparison family is applied.
hypotheses.statement: Same-clear-scene haze-density consistency adds information beyond the matched baseline objective.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The combined-versus-baseline lower bound exceeds 0.10 dB and the worst density-stratum lower bound is not below -0.10 dB.
hypotheses.falsifier: The combined utility gate is unfavorable or the worst density-stratum safety gate is unsafe.
hypotheses.statement: Combining CARL and density consistency produces material grouped utility without unacceptable degradation in the fixed worst density stratum.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: The published FFA-Net/RESIDE K=5 numerical results do not predict C2 effect sizes, gates, or PASS criteria; C2 is a K=4 transfer to ConvIR-B and Haze4K.
literature_basis.task: contrast-assisted reconstruction and haze-density consistency training losses
literature_basis.transferable_claim: A component ablation can separate reconstruction contrast loss, haze-density consistency, and their combination in a dehazing training objective.
